email_subject: Critical Security Vulnerability: Public disclosure of leaked customer session tokens
email_body:
Dear Security Team,

During an independent security assessment of your public API gateway, I identified that authorization bearer tokens are being logged in plain text in public telemetry endpoints.
Several active customer session tokens appear to be compromised and accessible without authentication.
Please initiate your security incident response procedure immediately.

Regards,
Alex Hunt
Security Researcher
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
